findings.title: Hardcoded AWS secret key in the test module
findings.body: A secret access key is hardcoded; move it to an env var or fixture.

findings.title: Assertion-free test: test_put_and_get_roundtrip never asserts
findings.body: The test exercises put/get but makes no assertion, so it cannot fail on a regression.

findings.title: Test constructs a real boto3 client and will fail in CI without a mock
findings.body: The client should be mocked or moto-backed or it will fail in CI.
